name: Shlink
description: Self-hosted URL shortener with a REST API, QR codes, and visit statistics.

envVars.description: Default domain used when generating short URLs
Optional MaxMind license key for visit geolocation

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DB_DRIVER: postgres
      DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      DB_NAME: shlink
      DB_USER: shlink
      DB_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
      DEFAULT_DOMAIN: {{env.DEFAULT_DOMAIN}}
      GEOLITE_LICENSE_KEY: {{env.GEOLITE_LICENSE_KEY}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/etc/shlink/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: shlink
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: shlink
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
